derivation: from H1172 (בַּעֲלָה) and H875 (בְּאֵר); mistress of a well;

occurrences.text: And all the villages that were round about these cities to Baalath–beer, Ramath of the south. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.
